rationale: A is more useful because it gives a concrete two-feature recommendation tied to the stated goal of first-month reach and includes at least some reasoning about why one path is more robust than a high-variance alternative. It also shows some KPI framing and uncertainty awareness. B gives a plausible recommendation, but it is mostly assertion: little comparison against other options, no caveats, no revisit triggers, and no quantitative support. A is still incomplete—its main alternative and revisit trigger are unclear, and the quantitative evidence appears thin—but it better supports a careful decision-maker.
